items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: And he never paid Alamone either. I took care of him now.

ctx.x: Because I got married in 1918. So maybe you were busy and gone.

I might have. And then I'm going to tell you, our family are peculiar people. If—if my—now, my sister was very, very selfish. She tried to keep her children and her husband, everybody to herself. And I was just different. My first husband and I separated. But my son knows all of his aunts. He has eight aunts and three uncles. And real and truly, he's down there with them now. Married, he's down there with them. His daughter lives next to his father. And as much as we separated, I didn't want to separate the…
Mm-hmm. Uh, had—you say he was sick in Chicago?
